caption.text:
I deleted forty carousels last month. Not because they were bad. Because they were all the same deck.

Same gradient. Same three-line hook. Same "save for later" slide. Every one of them looked like it had been extruded from the same template, because it had.

The ones that survived had one thing in common: a human had argued with them.

So now every deck has to pass one question — would a person have written this sentence out loud? If not, it gets cut.

That is the whole process. Unglamorous, effective.

slides.kicker: All forty were fine. That was the problem.
slides.headline: I deleted 40 carousels last month
slides.sub: Not one of them was broken. Every one of them was interchangeable.
slides.alt_text: Cover slide reading 'I deleted 40 carousels last month' on paper texture.

slides.headline: Templates do not fail loudly. They fail identically.
slides.note: Same gradient. Same three-line hook. Same recap with a bookmark icon. Forty decks that could have been one deck rendered forty times — because they were one prompt run forty times.
slides.callout: Nothing was wrong. Everything was the same.
slides.alt_text: Scrapbook slide with a paper card and a marker-underlined word.

slides.headline: What the survivors had

left.label: GENERATED
left.text: Ask an average of the internet and you get an average of the internet.
items: Balanced to the point of blankness

right.label: ARGUED WITH
right.text: A human cut one sentence and defended the rest.

slides.verdict: Taste is the edit, not the generation.
slides.alt_text: Contrast slide comparing generated decks with human-edited decks.

slides.headline: Why sameness costs you saves
slides.takeaway: Illustrative index from our own studio tests, not a platform benchmark.
slides.source: Internal study, 120 posts, Sept 2026 — illustrative only
slides.alt_text: Horizontal bars showing an illustrative save-rate index across three voice styles.

slides.headline: The one question I ask every deck
bullets: Would a person say this out loud?
Is one sentence doing the work?
Does it sound like anyone in particular?
Would I delete it without regret?
slides.alt_text: Five bullet checklist titled 'The one question I ask every deck'.

slides.headline: Send this to the templated one
slides.text: You know exactly which deck in your feed needs this. Send it over.
